verification.scope: No cross-device sync. Non-AI browser UX/platforms/core performance precede AI.
verification.method: Paginated GraphQL readback of every OPEN/CLOSED issue. Compare IDs, SHA-256 of JSON [title,body], parent/child sets, blockers, expected states/reasons and leaf labels. Compare all local Markdown bodies to exact publication inputs. Traverse dependencies to rule out AI on non-AI work paths.
